:::{#thm-universal-tm}
#### A universal Turing machine

There is a [Turing machine](#def-turing-machine) $U$ that runs any other machine from its
[description](#def-tm-description).
Given the [pair encoding](#def-pair-encoding) $\angb{w, x}$ of binary strings $w$ and $x$ as input,
$U$ [outputs](#def-turing-machine) $M_w(x)$ whenever $M_w$ [halts](#def-turing-machine) on $x$,
and runs forever when $M_w$ does not.
If $M_w$ halts on $x$ within $T$ steps,
then $U$ halts within $C \, T \log_2 T$ steps,
where $C$ depends on $M_w$ but not on $x$
[@arora2009computational, section 1.4].

:::
